## Summary

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` locally and tests pass.
- [ ] If this change affects a project, I updated or added the project's README.md.
- [ ] For database changes, EF Core migrations are included in `src/NetAdmin.Infrastructure`.
- [ ] Branch is named `feature/...`, `fix/...`, or `chore/...` and does not target main directly.

Notes for reviewers: Only @henrikmaurin will merge to `main`. CI (build-and-test) must pass before merging.
